claim_text: 500 ms delay + 20 % loss: every report within 30 s
what_the_evidence_shows_or_lacks: Nov 16 attempt 2, c4_bad_link.sh (500 ms + 20 % loss on BOTH directions at the Pi, about 1 s round trip and ~36 % loss per round trip), 21:52-21:58: 24 reports, median delay 2.07 s, max 53.1 s; 2 of 24 over 30 s (a heartbeat resent 14x, 37.9 s, and the walking change queued behind it, 53.1 s); longest silence 46 s; 0 missing seq, so nothing lost. Attempt 1 (outgoing only) was not valid. Likely cause: reports are sent strictly in order, so one report stuck in retries holds up the next (head-of-line blocking), on top of TCP back-off under heavy loss. Attempt 3 (Nov 19-20, 23:56-00:03, home Wi-Fi router instead of the phone hotspot, same degradation): 35 reports, median 1.53 s, 2 of 35 over 30 s (a heartbeat resent 13x, 35.2 s, and the change behind it, 32.7 s), 44 s silence, 0 lost: same head-of-line pattern on a different network
next_step: Report: discuss cause and design change (send activity changes ahead of heartbeats / do not let heartbeats block, reconnect when stalled); retest in Stage 2
